subject: SOC 2 gap request — bridge letter & interim evidence for ApexBio
messages:
From: Maria Torres <maria@apexbio.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@apexbio.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Bridge letter + evidence to cover post-report gap

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the demo last week. As part of our security intake for vendor onboarding I need to close the file on Redwood's SOC 2 Type II prior to procurement sign-off. I have the report you shared that ends 2026-06-30, but our audit window requires evidence through the contract start date (anticipated 2026-10-15). Can Redwood provide: 

- A bridge letter (or interim attestation) that covers the period 2026-07-01 through 2026-10-15, or at minimum through 2026-10-02 (today)
- A short controls summary indicating whether there have been any material changes to the controls tested in the SOC 2 report
- Recent evidence for the critical controls: user access review cadence, change management ticketing sample, and retention/purge policy enforcement

Timeline: procurement needs documents by EOD 2026-10-12 to make the October 20th commitment. Can you confirm whether this is possible and any steps we need to follow (e.g., NDAs to view internal attachments, DocuSign for any attestation)?

Appreciate a quick confirm and an outline of next steps.

Best,
Maria Torres
Head of Vendor Risk | ApexBio
+maria@apexbio.com

Attachments referenced: None in this email.

Hi Maria — thanks for the clear note and the timeline. We can provide a bridge letter that affirms there were no material changes to the control environment since the SOC 2 Type II report ending 2026-06-30, plus an internal controls summary and limited supporting evidence. Quick notes: 

- We'll attach: SOC2_TypeII_2026-06-30.pdf and a controls summary XLSX. For the ticketing and access review samples we'll provide redacted samples or screenshots as appropriate.
- We typically require a mutual NDA before sharing detailed operational artifacts; however, the bridge letter and the SOC 2 report PDF can be shared without an additional NDA. If you need deeper artifacts we can route them through a secured share after an approved data disclosure form.
- Timeline: I can get the SOC 2 PDF and a draft bridge letter to you by EOD 2026-10-05. If ApexBio signs the standard disclosure, we can provide additional evidence by 2026-10-12.

Next steps: 
1) Confirm whether the SOC 2 PDF + bridge letter (no attachments) is sufficient for procurement to move forward.
2) If yes, I will send the PDF + draft bridge letter now and loop in our compliance lead for formal sign-off.

Attaching the SOC 2 report and a controls summary for your review. If these work for procurement, I'll follow-up with the signed bridge letter.

Best regards,

Jordan — thanks for the ping and the draft plan. Draft language below for the bridge letter to ApexBio. I made it intentionally succinct for procurement consumption; we can expand if the customer asks for more controls detail. 

Draft bridge letter (for signature by Head of Compliance):

"To whom it may concern,

This letter is provided in connection with the SOC 2 Type II report issued to Redwood Inference for the period ending June 30, 2026. Based on our assessment of the control environment and the evidence reviewed since the report period, there have been no material changes to the controls addressed in the referenced SOC 2 report through October 2, 2026. Accordingly, Redwood Inference affirms that the SOC 2 report remains representative of the control environment as of that date.

This letter is provided solely for the benefit of the intended recipient in connection with its vendor risk assessment and may not be relied upon by any other party."

Action items: 
- I will attach a signed PDF of the bridge letter after Rishi confirms no outstanding exceptions.
- Rishi: can you confirm the access-review and change-management samples are clean and we can provide redacted screenshots? If yes, I'll coordinate signing and secure share.
